nodes.name: When Called
nodes.notes: ADR-053 Block 6 — output adapter. Turns the managed agent's final block-array (output_message: a fenced ```json array, the SAME structured block protocol the bare lane emits, decision #4) into the Post Reply (v1) contract {rendered_delta, image_manifest}. Reuses Image Resolver (v1)'s markdown->ClickUp-ops renderer (mdToOps, copied verbatim into Assemble) and Post Reply's existing image_manifest/{type:image_ref} upload path, so Post Reply is unchanged. Produced images are referenced by Files-API file_id (the managed lane emits {type:image, mode:embed_input, ref:file_...}); their bytes are NOT downloadable from the Files API (purpose=agent) and on the MCP path never return to n8n, so this adapter fetches them from the agent-output-images carrier bucket that Image Tool Handler persists them to (Block 6 carrier). Returns warnings[] for the caller (orchestrator, Block 8) to fire via Post Alert — branch-free terminal (Assemble), mirroring Image Resolver.

nodes.name: Parse Blocks
nodes.notes: Parse output_message into an ordered assembly (text + image placeholders gen_N) and the list of produced images to fetch (only image blocks whose ref is a Files-API file_id). Strips the ```json fence. A non-array payload falls back to one text block + a WARN (never a hard fail). An image ref that is not a file_id -> WARN + no manifest entry -> Assemble renders [Obraz niedostepny].

nodes.name: Has Images?
nodes.notes: TRUE: at least one produced image -> fetch its bytes from the carrier (Split Out -> Download). FALSE (text-only): skip straight to an empty manifest so Assemble still runs (a Code node does not execute on 0 input items — the empty-manifest branch keeps the terminal alive).

nodes.name: Split Out Images
nodes.notes: One item per produced image (placeholder_id, file_id, mime, caption, alt spread to root) so each is fetched from Storage independently. Paired-item idiom (mirrors Upload Input Images): Download + Extract resolve image meta via $('Split Out Images').item.

nodes.name: Download Image Bytes
nodes.notes: GET the produced image bytes from the private agent-output-images carrier bucket (keyed by Files-API file_id), via Supabase Storage REST with the predefined supabaseApi cred (service_role, bypasses RLS). responseFormat=file -> binary `data` (read as base64 in Extract). onError=continueErrorOutput: a missing object (carrier write failed, or already purged at 24h) -> Build Image Missing -> WARN + [Obraz niedostepny], never thrown.

nodes.name: Extract B64
nodes.notes: Download success -> read the binary base64 (item.binary.data.data) into a manifest-ready entry {placeholder_id, b64, mime, caption, alt}. An empty body -> ok:false + WARN (defensive).

nodes.name: Build Image Missing
nodes.notes: Download error branch -> the produced image cannot be delivered (carrier write failed or object purged). Emits ok:false + a WARN; Assemble renders [Obraz niedostepny] in its place. The image is omitted, the rest of the message still posts (fail-soft).

parameters.jsCode:
const meta = $('Split Out Images').item.json;
return { json: { ok: false, placeholder_id: meta.placeholder_id, file_id: meta.file_id, warning: 'output-adapter/image-bytes-missing: ' + (meta.file_id || '') + ' nie znaleziono w agent-output-images (zapis carrier mogl sie nie powiesc lub obiekt wygasl)' } };

nodes.name: Merge Images
nodes.notes: Converge fetched (0) and missing (1) image results into one stream so Aggregate Manifest keeps a single input.

nodes.name: Aggregate Manifest
nodes.notes: Build the image_manifest (only successfully-fetched images) + image warnings, as a single item for Merge Manifest -> Assemble.

nodes.name: Build Empty Manifest
nodes.notes: Text-only path (no produced images): empty manifest so Assemble still runs (keeps the single terminal alive when Split Out would yield 0 items).

nodes.name: Merge Manifest
nodes.notes: Converge the has-images manifest (0) and the empty manifest (1) into the single input Assemble reads. Exactly one branch runs per call.

nodes.name: Assemble
nodes.notes: SOLE TERMINAL (single input via Merge Manifest -> branch-free deterministic return). Walks the assembly in order: text -> mdToOps ops (verbatim from Image Resolver); image -> {type:image_ref, placeholder_id} when its bytes are in the manifest, else [Obraz niedostepny]. Returns the Post Reply (v1) contract {rendered_delta, image_manifest:[{placeholder_id,b64,mime,caption,alt}], warnings, total_image_cost_pln:0, image_models:[], clickup_task_id}. total_image_cost_pln is 0 here: the managed lane's per-image cost is logged separately in agent_runs by Generate Images Parallel, not carried in the comment footer (reconciled in Block 8/9).
